text:
ana: Seeing ~30 Pending GPU pods in ap-southeast1, lots of scale-ups that immediately scale down. Billing spike.
chris: scheduler trace?
ana: pasted: ```FailedScheduling: 0/40 nodes are available: 33 node(s) didn't match Pod's nodeAffinity; 7 node(s) had taints the pod didn't tolerate```
mike: sounds like the strict anti-affinity label from last year. Short-lived inferencers (1-2m) so cold-starts are wasting money.
jade: options: (1) mutate hard anti-affinity -> preferred; (2) route small jobs to MIG-capable nodes; (3) keep warmpool of 2 GPUs.
chanalytics: infra-bot posted autoscaler: "added 5 gpu nodes at 01:10, removed 5 at 01:12"
chris: prefer webhook to change scheduling to preferred for namespace=public-infer and label isolation=hard with annotation allow-relax=true. Safer than global change.
mike: will test MIG sharing in staging (node label node.k8s.io/gpu-mig=true). If perf ok, we can prefer MIG via webhook instead of breaking affinity.
jade: short-term I'd add scale-down-delay=10m on gpu pool and Pending GPU pods >20 for 5m alert.
ana: action items: ana -> write webhook prototype, chris -> scheduler scoring tweak PR, mike -> MIG perf run, jade -> autoscaler config and alert.
infra-bot: NOTE: maintenance 03:30-04:00 UTC. plan canary after 05:00 UTC.
ana: will schedule canary and post results here. :thumbsup:
